tree_semantics: The root is an administrative manager grouping. Child labels distinguish linguistic-family sublanes from administrative discovery cohorts; neither ancestry nor mutual intelligibility may be inferred from administrative edges.

nodes.label: Indonesian and Standard Malay surfaces
nodes.rule: Separate targets with an explicit crosswalk; shared forms require evidence.

nodes.label: Indonesian
nodes.production_state: Noether Paper 36 v001 built and visually checked

nodes.label: Malaysian Malay
nodes.script: Latin; Jawi only with target-specific evidence

nodes.label: Brunei Malay context
nodes.production_state: context evidence only; authority/inheritance decision needed

nodes.label: Singapore Malay context
nodes.production_state: context evidence only; authority/inheritance decision needed

nodes.label: Philippine Austronesian targets
nodes.rule: Filipino/Tagalog cannot substitute for regional languages.

nodes.label: Kra-Dai / Tai targets
nodes.rule: Local native editions; no Thai-Lao or family bridge without evidence.

nodes.label: Hmong-Mien targets
nodes.rule: Local orthography and target-specific source discovery.

nodes.label: Austroasiatic targets
nodes.rule: Vietnamese or Khmer evidence cannot stand for the family.

nodes.label: Tibeto-Burman / Himalayan administrative coverage
nodes.rule: No single broad bridge or unexamined family-wide inheritance.

nodes.label: Pacific Austronesian local targets
nodes.rule: Local standards and target-specific crosswalks; no broad Pacific language.

nodes.label: Papuan and Australian local-language discovery
nodes.rule: Select named local targets only; no Papuan or Australian bridge.

global_rules: CJK targets belong to the separate CJK manager and are not inherited here.
Contact/creole targets remain with their declared manager unless explicitly reassigned.
Every leaf target owns its terminology promotion and translation QA.
Reusable concept IDs and formula mappings may be shared; witness status may not.
